title: CtlSettingsResponse
description: `GET /v1/settings` (viewer) and the body a successful `PUT /v1/settings` job applies. Fleet-level knobs only: retention, default images, default Python env, the ctl block. `recipients` (the age backup recipients) is READ-ONLY here — recipients, unit templates, toolchains and anything else that decides what code runs or who can decrypt a backup are CLI-only trusted-operator changes. Image entries are pinned by digest; changing one over HTTP means choosing among SIFs already on disk under `/rag/apptainer/images`, never fetching.

keep_last.description: Counted over VERIFIED bundles only; the newest verified bundle is never pruned.

auto_delete.description: Constant false in v1: `backup prune` is `--dry-run` only.

count.description: 0 means backups FAIL CLOSED: a bundle cannot be written without someone able to decrypt its secrets.

fingerprints.description: Public-key fingerprints (`sha256:` + 16 hex) of the recipients — identifying, not secret.
